learner_operation: Read the integrand, simplify a product or quotient when necessary, identify each term's coefficient and exponent, integrate each term (raise the exponent by one and divide by that new exponent), preserve signs and combine. Radio learners must distinguish the resulting primitive from near-miss primitives; a blank preceding +C requests only its nonconstant part.

fixed_features.feature: Two nonzero elementary power terms after one product/quotient rewrite; no exponent -1 integration.
fixed_features.justification: q-49059 and q-49063 establish this moderate workload; tutorial 703 supplies linearity and constant extraction.

fixed_features.feature: Five math choices and one correct radio answer, or a single blank preceding supplied +C.
fixed_features.justification: These are the complete response contracts in the supported source banks.

fixed_features.feature: Modest powers, variable x, and real-domain assumptions.
fixed_features.justification: Keep algebra and workload comparable and define radicals/reciprocals; variable renaming is incidental and not needed for answer-role variation.

fixed_features.feature: Blank reduced integrand a+b/x^2, with degree 2 or 3 before cancellation.
fixed_features.justification: All three recovered blank sources have this same reduced form. Coefficients/signs vary independently; allowing arbitrary unrelated powers would broaden this finite source family.

fixed_features.feature: Quotient reciprocal-exponent multiset -1,-1,-1,-2,-3; exclude equal exponents on identical polynomial components.
fixed_features.justification: Conservative source-bank extension. Keeps five unique primitive choices and same two-power workload. Which polynomial component receives each exponent is eligible and is varied, rather than preserving the source assignment.

answer_roles.role: Which primitive in each radio bank is correct.
answer_roles.eligible_variation: All five slots, with shuffled display positions and jointly updated integrand/key/solution.
answer_roles.observed: All five targets sampled and controlled in both radio families; all survive delivery.

answer_roles.role: Pairing of polynomial coefficient/exponent with reciprocal exponent in quotient choices.
answer_roles.eligible_variation: Move the source multiset among polynomial primitives subject only to uniqueness.
answer_roles.observed: All 14 internal assignments tested at all 5 roles and 3 p values. They are seven unordered mathematical banks at fixed a,b,p; deduplication removes redundant copies without fixing polynomial correctness rank.

answer_roles.role: Signs and coefficients in both primitive terms.
answer_roles.eligible_variation: Independently signed small nonzero coefficients; change either term to require response reconsideration.
answer_roles.observed: All four sign pairs and boundaries covered. Relevant coefficient and same-denominator role pairs change actual accepted response.

answer_roles.role: Blank numerator degree and displayed choice ordering.
answer_roles.eligible_variation: Change degree 2 to 3 with corresponding f and denominator update; shuffle choices.
answer_roles.observed: Response remains equal for both irrelevant pairs, confirmed by exact math, native grading and actual UI rendering.

coverage.result: Five supported source cases; 258 controls include every quotient assignment x role x p, all source roles and sign boundaries, plus blank degrees.
272 raw attempts -> 240 unique prompts -> 240 delivered; control 258 -> 148 after duplicate removal; runner 5 -> 5. Denominators 2,3,4, both radical forms and blank survive.

coverage.case: Conditional rank cues before and after filtering.
coverage.result: No tested static cue is perfect in full structural controls or delivered controls, including each denominator/p cell and each radical form. Sign subgroups in fresh samples likewise have counterexamples.

coverage.case: Maximum count and conditional learner selection.
coverage.result: 1000 unique prompts after 2075 attempts; deterministic replay. All 240 delivered items selected across 12000 synthetic-ID, fresh-history moderate-band draws.

counterfactuals.change: Change target while holding coefficients, p and full bank fixed; specifically also hold denominator fixed in each of all 14 revised quotient assignments.
counterfactuals.expected: Prompt numerator, nonconstant primitive and worked solution change; previous choice rejected and current choice accepted.
counterfactuals.observed: All 14 same-denominator revised pairs and 8 original radio role pairs satisfy exact math, rendered text changes and native outcomes.
counterfactuals.justification: Correctness must follow the displayed integrand, not source role or denominator-conditioned polynomial rank. Tutorial 703; q-49059 and q-49063.

counterfactuals.change: Flip only b in the blank family (a=2, b=4 to -4, degree2).
counterfactuals.expected: Reciprocal term changes sign; solution and accepted response follow.
counterfactuals.observed: Before 2x-4/x and after 2x+4/x; opposite response rejected, current response accepted; both endpoints rendered.
counterfactuals.justification: q-167617 and the sum/difference rule require sign-sensitive integration.

counterfactuals.change: Degree2 to3 with f and denominator changed together; reverse radio display order.
counterfactuals.expected: Same mathematical answer and acceptance; displayed algebra/order changes coherently.
counterfactuals.observed: Both pairs preserve response and native acceptance; rendered prompts and controls inspected.
counterfactuals.justification: In the recovered blank family f/x^d=a+b/x^2 for either degree. Source radio contract depends on expression rather than choice position.
